title: Illinois's 11th Congressional District Election, 2026
description: The 2026 election for Illinois's 11th Congressional District pits incumbent Democratic Representative Bill Foster against Republican nominee Jeff Walter. Foster, a physicist and businessman who has represented the district since 2013, is seeking another term in a district covering Chicago exurbs including Aurora, Naperville, and Bolingbrook. The Cook Political Report rates the race as 'Solid D,' reflecting the district's Democratic lean (Cook PVI: D+6), though Walter, a retired Navy Master Chief and Elburn mayor, is running on a platform of affordability and fiscal conservatism. The general election will take place on November 3, 2026, following the March 17, 2026 primary where Foster was unopposed and Walter won a four-way Republican contest.
polling_note: No public opinion polls were found for this race as of June 2026.

candidates.name: Bill Foster
candidates.summary: Bill Foster is the incumbent Democratic U.S. Representative for Illinois's 11th Congressional District and the only physicist in Congress. A former Fermilab high-energy physicist and co-founder of Electronic Theatre Controls, he serves on the House Financial Services Committee (Ranking Member of the Subcommittee on Financial Institutions) and the Science, Space, and Technology Committee. Foster has represented the 11th District since 2013 and previously served Illinois's 14th District from 2008 to 2011.

candidates.name: Jeff Walter
candidates.summary: Jeff Walter is the Republican nominee for Illinois's 11th Congressional District and the current Mayor of Elburn, Illinois, serving his third term. A retired U.S. Navy Master Chief Petty Officer (E-9) with over 20 years of service, he also worked as an IT consultant and senior manager at Accenture before becoming mayor. Walter won a four-way Republican primary on March 17, 2026 with 42.6% of the vote, running on a platform focused on affordability, border security, tax cuts, and conservative fiscal policies.

forecast.rationale: No public polling exists for this race (zero polls as of June 2026), which inherently limits certainty. However, the structural fundamentals are exceptionally strong for the incumbent party: Cook Political Report rates the race 'Solid D,' the district has a D+6 Cook PVI, Bill Foster is a long-serving incumbent with strong name recognition (representing the district since 2013, previously served IL-14 from 2008), and he was unopposed in the Democratic primary. Jeff Walter is a credible Republican nominee—a retired Navy Master Chief and three-term Elburn mayor—but he won a divided four-way primary with only 42.6%, suggesting limited top-of-ticket strength. Given the combination of incumbency, favorable district partisanship, and the Cook 'Solid D' designation, the race falls into 'safe D' territory (95%+ Democratic win probability), though the complete absence of polling tempers confidence from high to medium.
